rumour_text: Adani Enterprises shares rally 4% on $686 million investment in not-for-profit healthcare initiative
label: denied
label_rationale: The company's Reg 30(11) filing states the reported Adani Health City initiative is being carried out by the Group's not-for-profit healthcare entities, not by Adani Enterprises Ltd itself, and that AEL is 'unable to comment' on an initiative that is not its own — i.e. it denies that the reported activity belongs to the listed entity.

rumour_text: Speculative Moneycontrol report on a major Coforge acquisition/deal ahead of the company's own board-approved disclosure
label: unaddressed
label_rationale: The company's filing calls the report 'speculative and premature' without confirming or denying the substance of the deal, and points to a future board-approved disclosure process instead. Under the labeling framework this is a non-committal response, not a confirm or deny.
notes: Exact rumour date approximate — see filing F002 notes on sourcing confidence.

rumour_text: IREDA has declared Gensol Engineering's ~Rs 673 crore loan accounts as fraud and reported the matter to the RBI
rumour_source_publication: NSE clarification letter referencing media coverage
label: confirmed
label_rationale: The company's filing explicitly states 'the contents of the said reports are factually correct and are based on the aforesaid order issued by IREDA' — a direct confirmation.

rumour_text: Government of India has finalised a revised bid of Rs 81/share from Fairfax Financial Holdings for the IDBI Bank stake sale
rumour_source_publication: Business news reports on the Fairfax bid revision
label: unaddressed
label_rationale: IDBI Bank's filing explicitly states it is 'not in a position to either confirm or deny' the report — a textbook non-committal response under Reg 30(11), since the disinvestment process is run by the Government/LIC rather than the bank itself.
notes: Rumour and filing dates are approximate — see filing F004 notes on sourcing confidence.

rumour_text: Vedanta Aluminium has raised close to Rs 13,500 crore in loans from Axis Bank, HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank to refinance debt after the group demerger
label: unaddressed
label_rationale: The company's own clarification is generic boilerplate ('continuously evaluates various financing opportunities... will disclose under Regulation 30 as required') and does not confirm or deny the specific loan amount or lenders reported in the media, even though subsequent media coverage treated the transaction as having occurred.

rumour_text: Ola Electric Likely In SEBI Crosshairs Over Alleged Insider Trading
rumour_source_publication: Business news report on an alleged SEBI insider-trading probe
label: denied
label_rationale: The company's filing states the article's contents are 'factually inaccurate', explains the trades were routine ESOP-related transactions, and 'categorically denies the allegation of insider trading'.

rumour_text: Enforcement Directorate is investigating One97 Communications (Paytm), its associates and Founder/CEO for anti-money-laundering violations
rumour_source_publication: Speculative media reports circulating around early February 2024
label: denied
label_rationale: The company's BSE/NSE filing 'categorically denies any investigation by the Enforcement Directorate' and separates the unrelated RBI supervisory action on Paytm Payments Bank from the alleged ED probe.

rumour_text: Adani Group is in talks to acquire a stake in One97 Communications (Paytm)
rumour_source_publication: Business news reports of a purported Adani-Paytm stake talks
label: denied
label_rationale: Paytm's filing calls the report 'speculative and untrue' and states the company is 'not engaged in any discussions with the Adani Group in this regard'.

rumour_text: Blackstone is trimming its stake in Mphasis
rumour_source_publication: Business news reports on a purported Blackstone stake sale
label: confirmed
label_rationale: Mphasis confirms the underlying fact — its promoter BCP Topco IX (part of Blackstone) has indicated it may sell up to 1.8 crore shares — while clarifying that the listed entity itself is not a transacting party. The substantive claim (an intended stake sale) is confirmed.

rumour_text: Jio Financial Services is in talks to acquire Paytm's wallet business
rumour_source_publication: Business news reports on a purported Jio Financial-Paytm wallet deal
label: denied
label_rationale: Jio Financial Services' filing states the report is 'speculative' and that the company 'has not been in any negotiations in this regard'.

rumour_text: Hinduja Group is seeking a strategic partner to hold a minority stake in IndusInd Bank
label: denied
label_rationale: IndusInd Bank's filing states 'there is no discussion of this nature underway with anyone in the bank', directly denying the reported strategic-partner talks.
